title: Half of / Some of / A Lot of
theory:
Rule
                                                                Plural Noun + Plural Verb
                                                                 e.g. Half of the girls are here.
       Half / Half of / Some / Some of /
                                                                Singular Noun + Singular Verb
       Enough / Enough of / A lot of / Lots of
                                                                 e.g. Half of the apple is fresh.
                                                                Uncountable Noun + Singular Verb
                                                                 e.g. Half of the water is cold.
